source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC Web UI -> Click "Sensor" from the menu bar.
2. Click "Sensor detail" to check each sensor. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
3. Jam PSU FAN by a cable ties and check BMC SEL and health LED.
4. Recover and check the PSU status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range.
2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui
3. BMC should record the error message and health LED shoule be amber when trigger error.
4. PSU status should recover after remove the cable ties.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Cold Reboot 25 times: perform 25 cold reboots via ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" power off; ipmitool power on. Agent loops the power-off/on 25x and logs host/BMC after each.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return each cold-reboot boot marker + final ipmitool -I lanplus -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sel elist 2>&1 | tail -30 so the user confirms 25 clean cold reboots; long run - confirm approval.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: 25 cold power-off cycles; dedicated SUT + approval.

original_test_intent: Obstruct each mapped PSU fan safely, verify WebUI/IPMI sensor agreement, SEL and amber health indication, then remove the obstruction and prove PSU recovery.
original_method: An engineer installs/removes a physical fan obstruction while WebUI, IPMI, SEL and the chassis LED are observed.
manual_activity: Engineer installs/removes the approved obstruction and observes the health LED; the agent can automate sensor/SEL comparison and recovery evidence.
required_inputs: Expected SEL, LED, PSU state and recovery timing
safety_requirements: Do not use cable ties against a rotating fan unless vendor-approved and non-damaging.
Confirm redundancy, thermal margin and immediate release.
Stop on temperature, PSU or redundancy fault; no automatic retry.
Restore free rotation and verify the PSU before continuing.
agent_execution_scope: Capture mapped WebUI exports, IPMI sensor data, SEL, PSU power/health and recovery around each engineer stimulus.
Do not jam hardware, claim LED observation or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/apply/remove fixture and observe LED/physical fan.
